questions.question: Why did Haman become enraged at Mordecai?
options: Mordecai had openly insulted his name
Mordecai had taken his place at court
Mordecai owed him a great sum of money
Mordecai would not bow down to him
questions.answer: Mordecai would not bow down to him

questions.question: What did Haman plot to do?
options: Seize the royal throne for himself
Destroy all the Jews throughout the kingdom
Lay a heavy and crushing tax on the Jews
Drive Mordecai out of the whole city in disgrace
questions.answer: Destroy all the Jews throughout the kingdom
